title: Parallel UI implementation lane
reproduced_failure: A single product-development selector caused UISR setup to pause/close active MCS work even though the owner intended both work streams to continue.
repair: Add a persistent ui-implementation lane, restore product-development/MCS authority, define lane-local authority and same-repository publication serialization, and add regression validation.
acceptance: CURRENT simultaneously represents product-development/MCS-18 and ui-implementation/UISR-01 as in_progress with lane-local authority.
LANES routes UI skin runtime work to ui-implementation while ordinary roadmap implementation remains product-development.
Operating contract explicitly forbids one active lane from implicitly pausing another.
Validator/test coverage requires the new lane and checks current/checkpoint consistency.
Same-repository publication remains serialized by the existing merge-lease protocol.
